name: scientific-agent-skills
description: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist. The #1 Agent Skills library for science, used by 190,000+ scientists worldwide. 165 ready-to-use validated skills plus 100+ scientific databases covering biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. Compatible with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Antigravity, and the open Agent Skills standard.
one_liner: A library of ready-made research skills that turns any AI assistant into a lab-grade research helper for biology, chemistry, and medicine.
buyer: A biotech startup founder who needs bioinformatics-level research support but can't yet afford a bioinformatics hire.
business_use_cases: A two-person biotech startup uses it to run literature reviews, variant lookups, and drug-target screening without a dedicated bioinformatician.
A university lab wires it into their internal tools so grad students get instant, sourced answers instead of digging through 100+ scientific databases by hand.
A regulatory consultant speeds up pharmacokinetic and dose-selection literature summaries for client filings.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a "set it up and train your lab" consulting package for small biotech and pharma teams who want this running but lack the technical staff.
Sell a managed, hosted version with usage-based billing for labs that don't want to self-host or maintain it.

steal_this: Offer a paid one-day "research assistant setup" service to a local biotech or university lab this weekend — install it, wire it to their workflow, and train two people to use it.
